Each system can provide a cold storage environment for the cabinet separately as a refrigeration unit. The refrigeration mode of each system is a single-machine self-cascade refrigerating system, namely, a compressor is used for compressing the refrigerant at different evaporation temperatures, and then the medium-tempe

p: HAIER BIOMEDICAL\24-1.售后服务手册DW-86L578、728、828BPST  Service Manual-10.18.pdf
t: is a single-machine self-cascade refrigerating system, namely, a compressor is used for compressing the refrigerant at different evaporation temperatures, and then the medium-temperature and the low-temperature refrigerant are separated by a gas-liquid separator; the medium-temperature refrigerant is allowed to cool and condense the low-temperature refrigerant in the intercooler, so that the low-temperature refrigerant reaches the liquid state and achieve the refrigeration effect after throttling. 7-2. Connect power supply and turn on the instrument switch to operate the instrument This section introduces the functions and features of CryoBio liquid nitrogen management system, and how to access and adjust various user settings and options. The main functions of CryoBio liquid nitrogen management system include automatic control of liquid nitrogen filling, liquid level monitoring, temperature monitoring and data recording, operation record, liquid nitrogen supply detection and authority management. 1. Liquid Level Detection The liquid level monitoring of CryoBio liquid nitrogen management system adopts a capacitance sensor for measurement. The capacitance sensor is placed onto the liner side wall from the neck of liquid nitrogen tank. When a certain section of the capacitance sensor is immersed in liquid nitrogen, the capacitance value of the capacitance sensor will change. The instrument obtains the current liquid level value through conversion of capacitance value. The capacitance

trogen, the capacitance value of the capacitance sensor will change. The instrument obtains the current liquid level value through conversion of capacitance value. The capacitance sensor is not affected by air pressure and temperature, with high measurement accuracy and low failure rate. 2. Liquid Level Control Liquid level control is to maintain the liquid level height in the liquid nitrogen biological container according to user-defined parameters. The instrument has three control modes: manual mode, gas phase mode (automatic/manual control) and liquid phase mode (automatic/manual control), and each mode has independent control parameters. Ultrahigh level alarm value: When the liquid level reaches or exceeds the set value, a high liquid level alarm will be triggered. Stopping liquid refilling height: When the liquid level reaches or exceeds the set value, CryoBio liquid nitrogen management system will close the refilling solenoid valve and stop liquid refilling in both gas and liquid phase modes. Ultralow level alarm value: When the liquid level is equal to or lower than the set va

se the refilling solenoid valve and stop liquid refilling in both gas and liquid phase modes. Ultralow level alarm value: When the liquid level is equal to or lower than the set value, a low liquid level alarm will be triggered. Automatic refilling height: When the liquid level is lower than or equal to the set value, CryoBio liquid nitrogen management system will start the automatic refilling function in both gas and liquid phase modes, and the control terminal will automatically refill liquid. Manual control: When the manual control is used for manual liquid refilling, the system will automatically close the solenoid valve and stop liquid refilling when it reaches the stopping liquid refilling height or automatic liquid refilling time. Manual mode: When the manual mode is used, both liquid nitrogen supply and stopping need to be manually controlled. The system will not automatically start liquid nitrogen supply control or stop liquid refilling control, and all controls need to be manually operated. 3. supply control or stop liquid refilling control, and all controls need to be manually operated. 3. The temperature probe adopts Pt-100 temperature sensor, with high accuracy and fast temperature sensitivity. Precautionary measures, product use and daily maintenance 7.1 Refrigeration principle of the ultra-low temperature frequency conversion and G series/Yunneng series The cryogenic freezer T series uses a cascade refrigeration system which generally consists of two or more refrigeration systems (referred to as high -temperature stage refrigeration system and low -temperature stage refrigeration system respectively). The high-temperature stage part uses medium-temperature refrigerants, while the low-temperature stage refrigeration part uses low -temperature refrigerants. The two parts, each of which is a complete refrigeration system, are connected by a condensing evaporator which serves as a high -temperature stage evaporator and a low -temperat

. The two parts, each of which is a complete refrigeration system, are connected by a condensing evaporator which serves as a high -temperature stage evaporator and a low -temperature stage condenser simultaneously. The low -temperature refrigerants inside the evaporator of the low-temperature stage system absorb heat from the cooled objects and transfer it to the refrigerants in the high-temperature stage system via the condensing evaporator. The refrigerants in the high -temperature stage system then transfer the heat to the refrigerating medium via the high-temperature stage condenser. The frequency conversion series uses frequency conversion compressor technology and a dual -compressor Ultra-Low Temperature (ULT) Frequency Conversion/G series/Yunneng Series After-sales Service Manual 46 cascade refrigeration system design to ensure better system reliability. Dep ending on the inner temperature requirements, the compressor speed can be automatically adjusted to control the cooling capacity of the system. Therefore, the temperature fluctuation inside the freezer is smaller and the

Therefore, the temperature fluctuation inside the freezer is smaller and the uniformity is better In the stable operation stage, a low speed and low cooling capacity are used, thus reducing both the noise and the power consumption. the ambient temperature is lower than 30℃ (including 30℃), the set temperature will be adjusted to the original set value; D. Why the temperature of the freezer rises so fast when the door is opened, while freezers of other brands have no such a problem? (1) The temperature of the ULT freezer is very low, which means that there is a large temperature difference between it and the ambient temperature, and our temperature sensing probe is very sensitive, so the temperature rises faster when the door is opened. upporting, and adjustable depending on the requirements, are provided with the product. Ultra-Low Temperature (ULT) Frequency Conversion/G series/Yunneng Series After-sales Service Manual 56 There are three cases: The first case is that the large difference between inside and outside temperature results in a negative pressure state of the door body. BIOLOGICAL SAFETY CABINET 2 Product Presentation 27 Dear Haier Customers, The Haier biological safety cabinet is designed with a ultra-low penetration air filter (ULPA). The filtration efficiency is higher than 99.999% at 0.12 ym. The work space cleanliness is higher than Class 10. We hope our product will provide a reliable safe environment for you. The biological safety cabinet is to create an experimental environment that involves microbiological operation. The unit performs with high efficiency to provide safety for personnel, experimental objects and work environment. The negative pressure air curtain at the opening of the biological safety cabinet prevents contaminated aerosol from leaking out and harming p

imental objects and work environment. The negative pressure air curtain at the opening of the biological safety cabinet prevents contaminated aerosol from leaking out and harming personnel. The vertical one-way airflow filtered by the ULPA supplies the experimentation with clean airflow betterthan Class 10, so as to protect the experiment objects. The exhaust gas from the ULPA already has the microorganisms and dust adequately filtered, so as to protect the environment. The design, manufacture and testing of the biological safety cabinet of Haier completely comply with the industrial standard Biological Safety Cabinet (YY0569-2011) and also take into account the USA standard Class II (Laminar Flow) Biological Safety Cabinet (NSF/ANSI49-2009), the European standard Performance Criteria for Biological Safety Cabinet (EN12469-2000) and Australian standard Class II Biological Safety Cabinet –Design(AS 2252.2-2009). Biological safety cabinet is extensively applied in research, education, clinical examination and production concerning microbiology, biomedical science, genetic recombination and biological products. It is the most basic protection equipment in the primary protection system for biological safety in a laboratory. It provides a sterile, dustless and mobile work environment for health care, pharmacy and scientific research. This product is based on a negative pressure ventilation cabinet consisting of a ULPA and a negative pressure chamber and it is intended to protect the experiment operator, experiment environment and experiment materials and to prevent the infection and attack by the aerosol generated by the hazardous biological factors.
